description: Junior Secondary School 1 Mathematics - Foundation topics covering number systems, basic algebra, geometry, and statistics

subtopics.title: Number Bases and Place Value
concepts: Writing numbers in words and figures
learning_objectives: Read and write numbers up to one billion
Identify place value of digits in numbers
common_misconceptions: Confusing place value with face value
Difficulty reading large numbers with zeros

subtopics.title: Counting and Writing Numbers
common_misconceptions: Confusing odd numbers with prime numbers

subtopics.title: Types of Fractions
learning_objectives: Convert between improper fractions and mixed numbers
common_misconceptions: Thinking larger denominators mean larger fractions
Difficulty converting mixed numbers to improper fractions

subtopics.title: Operations on Fractions
learning_objectives: Add and subtract fractions with different denominators
Multiply fractions by fractions and whole numbers
Divide fractions by fractions and whole numbers
common_misconceptions: Forgetting to invert when dividing fractions

subtopics.title: Decimal Notation and Operations
learning_objectives: Perform all four operations on decimals
common_misconceptions: Confusion about decimal place movement in multiplication

subtopics.title: Percentage Concepts and Calculations
concepts: Expressing one quantity as percentage of another
learning_objectives: Convert between percentages, fractions, and decimals
Calculate percentage of a given amount
common_misconceptions: Thinking percentage always means out of 100 only
Confusing percentage increase with percentage of

subtopics.title: Lowest Common Multiple
learning_objectives: Determine LCM of two or more numbers using different methods
common_misconceptions: Stopping at the first common multiple

subtopics.title: Highest Common Factor
learning_objectives: Find all factors of a number
Determine HCF of two or more numbers
Apply LCM and HCF to real-life problems

subtopics.title: Rounding Numbers
common_misconceptions: Confusing decimal places with significant figures

subtopics.title: Introduction to Algebra
learning_objectives: Simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms
common_misconceptions: Treating letters as standing for objects rather than numbers

subtopics.title: Simple Equations
learning_objectives: Form and solve equations from word problems
common_misconceptions: Applying operations to only one side of equation

subtopics.title: Lines and Line Segments
concepts: Types of lines (straight, curved, parallel, perpendicular)
common_misconceptions: Thinking parallel lines must be equal in length

subtopics.title: Angles
concepts: Types of angles (acute, obtuse, right, reflex, straight)
learning_objectives: Identify and classify angles by size
Calculate unknown angles using angle properties
common_misconceptions: Thinking angle size depends on arm length

subtopics.title: Types of Polygons
concepts: Quadrilaterals (square, rectangle, parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, kite)
Sum of angles in a triangle
Sum of angles in a quadrilateral
learning_objectives: Name and classify polygons by number of sides
Identify properties of different triangles and quadrilaterals
Calculate unknown angles in triangles and quadrilaterals
common_misconceptions: Thinking all triangles have a right angle

subtopics.title: Area
learning_objectives: Calculate area of rectangles, squares, and triangles

subtopics.title: Graphical Representation
learning_objectives: Draw and interpret pictograms, bar charts, and pie charts

subtopics.title: Ratio
concepts: Dividing quantities in a given ratio

subtopics.title: Proportion
learning_objectives: Solve problems involving direct and inverse proportion
Apply unitary method to real-life situations
